title: Wadsworth African Fellowship
about: The Wenner-Gren Foundation's Wadsworth African Fellowship supports African doctoral students in anthropology at South African universities, for fellowships beginning in the following academic year. The online portal opens 1 November and applications, with both sponsor letters, are due 15 December 2026.
requirements: Citizens and residents of an African country at the time of application
Members of a group underrepresented in academic anthropology and archaeology
Doctoral application pending at a South African university, or in the first year of the doctoral programme
Applicants seeking only fieldwork or dissertation write-up support are not eligible
Two sponsor letters (home and host) must arrive by the deadline; application in English

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: requirement "Doctoral application pending at a South African university, or in the first year of the doctoral programme" → objective "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

requirement "Applicants seeking only fieldwork or dissertation write-up support are not eligible" (early-stage doctoral work) → objective "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
Note: the catalog has no anthropology course; the match covers early doctoral research skills, not the discipline itself.
